text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Sonic 3: Angel Island Revisited is a fan-made restoration project that rebuilds Sonic the Hedgehog 3 using a modern engine while preserving the original gameplay. Released in 2019, it adds widescreen support, improved audio options, new features, bug fixes, and expanded customization while maintaining the feel of the Sega Genesis original. The project is based on a reverse-engineered version of the Retro Engine and is known for enhancing one of Sonic's classic platforming titles.
